description.value: Almost all datasets chosen for the LCA refer to the RoW as the geographic reference as no national specific environmental profiles were available.  Production electricity has been calculated based on the production year 2022. The product at the deconstruction phase (C1) will be crushed and is therefore allocated to the waste scenario “concrete”.

timeRepresentativenessDescription.value: All product- and process-specific data were collected for the operating year 2022 and are thus up-to-date.

descriptionOfRestrictions.value: Almost all datasets chosen for the LCA refer to the RoW as the geographic reference as no national specific environmental profiles were available. The results of this EPD are representative for European Union.

technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse.value: The product to be declared is an average of weldable reinforcing steel. A range of rebars A500 class (B500B) diameters from 10 mm to 32 mm. The product to be declared are rebars from JSC “Uzmetcombinat”, which are produced in the steel mill of the plant located at Sirdarya str. 1, Bekabad city, Tashkent region, Republic of Uzbekistan. The production process consists of next stages: 1. Acceptance of scrap and waste of ferrous metals; 2. Production stage 1: - Metal scrap sorting, - Lime production, - FeSiMn production, - FeSi production; 3. Production stage 2:  - Steel melting, - Steel rolling. The warehouse of scrap and waste of ferrous metals are near by the steel melting shop. JSC “Uzmetcombinat” himself produces raw materials - lime, ferrosilicon and ferrosilicomanganese. These production are part of a continuous production process, during which the technological wastes are used as by-products not used part sells to third-party manufacturers as raw materials. All warehouse raw materials are placing into a EAF (Electric Arc Furnace) and melting. The melting process consists of several stages, during which additives are added to obtain the required composition of steel. Steel rolling process starts from steel billets, witch are steel melting products with a square cross-section and rounded edges produced by continuous casting, forming. They serve as starting material for the hot rolling process. Wire rod are produced from hot rolling steel billets on special continuous rolling mills, after getting required diameter starts cutting the wire rods to the required length.
